description: One extension installed on this site, with its build, version and capabilities. Deleting it removes its files, doctype grants and extension state, but keeps any doctype, token or client script the extension made.

fields.description: The extension's namespaced identity, in the form "publisher/name".
fields.label: Extension

fields.description: Where the files came from. Shown in the panel, but not part of the extension's identity. Empty for an extension installed from a directory.
fields.label: Source URL

fields.description: Off stops this extension for every user.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: A brief summary shown below the label in the Extensions panel.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: One SVG file in the install root, such as icon.svg. The editor draws it beside the extension.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: The extension's README, in Markdown. Builder Hub sends it, or the installer reads it from the author's folder.
fields.label: Readme

fields.description: A hash of the installed files. It also keys the editor frame, so a rebuild remounts the frame.
fields.label: Checksum

fields.description: JSON list of capability keys the manifest asked for. A grant cannot reach outside this list.
fields.label: Requested Capabilities

fields.description: JSON list of capability keys an extension manager granted. A key absent here is not granted.
fields.label: Granted Capabilities

fields.description: A Hub install starts as Installing while a background job downloads it. It then becomes Ready or Failed. Every other install path is Ready right away.
fields.label: Install State

fields.description: Why the last Hub install did not finish. Shown in the panel with a Retry.
fields.label: Install Error

name: Builder Extension
